args.code: (() => { const h = document.querySelector('h1,h2')?.innerText || ''; const url = location.pathname; const buttons = [...document.querySelectorAll('button')].map(b => b.innerText.trim()).filter(Boolean).slice(0,20); const inputs = [...document.querySelectorAll('input,select,textarea')].map(el => ({tag:el.tagName,type:el.type||'',ph:el.placeholder||'',name:el.name||el.getAttribute('aria-label')||'',val:(el.value||'').slice(0,40)})).slice(0,20); const rows = document.querySelectorAll('table tbody tr, table tr').length; const alerts = [...document.querySelectorAll('[role=alert],.error,.text-red-500,.text-destructive,.text-red-600')].map(e => e.innerText.trim()).filter(Boolean).slice(0,5); const empty = [...document.querySelectorAll('main')].map(m => m.innerText).join(' ').includes('Belum ada') || [...document.querySelectorAll('main')].map(m => m.innerText).join(' ').toLowerCase().includes('no data') || [...document.querySelectorAll('main')].map(m => m.innerText).join(' ').includes('kosong'); const main = (document.querySelector('main')?.innerText || '').slice(0,600).replace(/\s+/g,' '); return JSON.stringify({url,h,buttons,inputs,rows,alerts,empty,main}); })()
